label: No unexplained absence at roots, from essence-grounded modality and positive ESSENCE_6
description: Fix an actual root r at w and a determination d that r lacks while some admissible profile q contains all of r's determinations and d (an unexplained absence). Positivity makes every ESSENCE_6 condition on r's profile hold of q. Essence-grounded modality then gives a world v accessible from w at which r has every member of q, in particular d. Necessity of the root's absences gives r the determination d at w, a contradiction. So no actual root has an unexplained absence. The derivation is a relocation: under N, EM and factivity of essential conditions, positivity is equivalent to the conclusion (Lean-only positivityOfNoUnexplainedAbsence), so the argument adds the warrant of N and EM, which have support outside this dispute, and moves the contested load to positivity. The main theorem uses no axioms. The Comparator companion essenceControls (three Mathlib axioms; the #2153 carrier with the open family, the source the only actual root) gives a positive witness and, for each premise, a row where it fails, the other two hold and the conclusion fails: a contingent lack of noesis (N fails), a necessary lack that no nature grounds (EM fails), and a nature with the negative clause 'lacks noesis' (positivity fails). The rows are assignments of the stated relations, not models of essence.
